questions.q: What is the actual fix for this bug?
options: Rename the Drill-Down page's Total Sales card
Delete Total Sales (All Regions) entirely
Rewrite the DAX formula for Total Sales (All Regions)
Rebind the Executive Summary's headline card from Total Sales (All Regions) to the plain Total Sales measure
questions.explain: Since this was diagnosed as a binding mistake, the fix is rebinding the visual, not changing any measure's formula.

questions.q: Why does Total Sales (All Regions) stay in the model after the fix?
options: It is actually unused and could be deleted for no reason
It's a correct, legitimate measure still needed as the denominator inside Pct of Company Total
Power BI requires at least two measures per table
Deleting measures is not technically possible in Power BI
questions.explain: The measure's DAX was never wrong — only its binding to the wrong visual was the problem.

questions.q: Why should validation check every territory, not just the one originally reported (Pacific)?
options: The original mistake was invisible with no filter applied, so testing only one narrow case could hide a new problem the same way
Checking more than one region has no real benefit
Power BI requires testing exactly ten territories
Pacific is not a valid AdventureWorks2012 territory
questions.explain: A thorough validation pass covers multiple filter states, including the unfiltered state, to avoid missing a similar blind spot.

questions.q: Why doesn't renaming Total Sales (All Regions) break Pct of Company Total, which references it?
options: It does break it, and the formula must be manually retyped
Renaming measures is not allowed once a report is published
Power BI Desktop updates references to a measure automatically when it's renamed, since the reference is to the object, not typed text
Pct of Company Total doesn't actually use that measure
questions.explain: DAX measure references are object references; renaming updates every formula that calls it automatically.

questions.q: What defensive change reduces the odds of a similar mis-binding in the future?
options: Removing all measures from the model
Renaming the benchmark measure for clarity and grouping it with Pct of Company Total in a 'Benchmarks' display folder
Hiding the Fields pane entirely
Renaming Total Sales to something unrelated to sales
questions.explain: A clearer name plus a display folder separates benchmark-style measures from plain, filter-responsive ones in the Fields pane.
